sum: Prestige Estates Projects Limited filed a mandatory SEBI Takeover Regulations disclosure (Regulation 31(4)) with NSE, indicating a substantial acquisition of shares or change in control event requiring public disclosure.
detail: Prestige Estates Projects Limited submitted a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, to NSE. This disclosure is mandatory when a person or group acquires shares such that their holding crosses prescribed thresholds (typically 25% or higher, or when acquisition of control occurs). The filing on 19 June 2026 signals either acquisition of >25% shareholding or a change in control event.
